notes: P05 task SACMAT-traces (PolicyTrace RQ1-RQ3): append-only JSONL recording with strictly monotonic event IDs, raw outcome, reason code, oracle decision, delegation lineage/digest references, CPU/DB duration/cost metrics, actual backend, and sensitive field sanitization. evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/trace_writer.py implements write_trace(event)->sha256 exact contract, TraceWriter append-only recorder with cryptographic hash chain (prev_digest, payload_digest, entry_digest), automatic adaptation of _shared.harness pair_result objects, recursive sanitization of credentials and PII (passwords, secrets, tokens, API keys, patient names, SSNs, emails, phone numbers), and verify_trace(trace_path)->bool for tamper, monotonicity, and leak detection. Real sample trace artifact emitted at research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/sacmat_trace_sample.jsonl recording 6 distinct SACMAT conformance events (conformant grant, delegation cycle, revocation-before-replay, delegation expiry, revoked actor transitivity, indeterminate unestablished authority) across candidate, cedar, openfga, and opa backends. All positive and adversarial tests pass (25 tests covering monotonicity, hash chaining, lineage, duration/cost, resumption, sanitization, tampering with outcomes/reasons/lineage/durations/digests, and credential/PII leak detection).
